answer.summary: The API Types Check failed because the committed front-end types in openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts do not match the types generated from the running API. The step prints a diff adding fields such as XtmComposerRegisterInput image and version, then reports 'Forgot to generate types'. This is deterministic for this commit, so a re-run will fail the same way. Regenerate with 'yarn generate-types-from-api' and commit the result. The log does not show which change caused the drift, since some diffed types are outside the touched files.

evidence.quote: +  /** The container image XTM Composer runs from, optional */
⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
